component: Notification action object naming and archive dispatch

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The reviewed action objects use l10nId for the Fluent key, isValidFor(message) for eligibility and runAction(message) for dispatch. The reviewer requested l10nId/runAction; actual landed source adopts them even though the rows remain NotDone. Archive eligibility delegates canArchive([message], true), which checks the single message identity archiveEnabled path. Starting archiveMessages is not proof of completion; the browser test waits for the folder event before checking the moved message. This is a local action-object convention, not a global method-name rule. No runtime test ran.
title: Notification action objects use l10nId, isValidFor and runAction for separate roles
